card.name: Sentence-subject words in website disclaimers
card.fires_on: Small words such as "we", "is", "are", or a closing parenthesis right before a verb or clause continues. Seen in website terms-of-use or disclaimer text, and in the sulfite sensitivity and Catholic Encyclopedia passages.

modes.description: "is" follows a repeated topic phrase and leads into a claim about frequency.

card.writes: The promoted tokens (bel, Bel) suggest it pushes toward a "bel" word start such as "belongs", while suppressing unrelated pieces.
card.plain: It fires on small words like "we" or "is" in site disclaimers, where a verb such as "belongs" may come next.
